summary_md: **Bin Lian ([@BinLiano9m5](https://x.com/BinLiano9m5/status/2115081092659102151))** shares **Trace Canvas**, which maps parallel Claude Code and Codex sessions on one project as a transit map, lets an agent tidy it, and shows which session is waiting on you.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - CallSymmetryEcho/trace-canvas: A transit map of parallel AI agent work: threads and records on a canvas, a git-style branch graph and a timeline. Claude Code hooks, MCP server and skill; no dependencies.

relevance: Visibility tooling for many concurrent agent sessions.
